title: ranunculus ficaria f. disjunctus
intro: Ranunculus ficaria f. disjunctus, commonly known as Lesser Celandine, is a perennial plant species in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, as well as promoting digestion and skin health. The therapeutic actions of Lesser Celandine include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as ranunculin, protoanemonin, and isoferulic acid. These compounds may contribute to the plant's potential health benefits, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
